$comment: Cross-language authority for room input validation: the task-status vocabulary and command-field limits. chatBodyMaxLength is pre-encryption client UX policy shared by Rust and Swift; the backend separately enforces the encrypted-envelope byte limit because it cannot inspect plaintext. The remaining values are backend request/domain policy mirrored by Rust and Swift. .NET ProtocolAuthorityTests, Rust tests/protocol_lock.rs, and Swift WireAuthorityTests pin the applicable values. Changing a value requires updating every named consumer.
